definitions.explanation: A day when one doesn't work, a day off.

examples.japanese: {休日|きゅうじつ}は{何|なに}をしますか。
examples.english: What do you do on holidays?

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}は{休日出勤|きゅうじつしゅっきん}が{二回|にかい}もあった。
examples.english: This month, I had to work on my day off twice.

examples.japanese: {休日|きゅうじつ}を{楽|たの}しむ。
{休日|きゅうじつ}は{家族|かぞく}と{過|す}ごすことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: I often spend my days off with my family.

examples.japanese: {休日|きゅうじつ}に{仕事|しごと}のメールが{来|く}ると、{少|すこ}し{嫌|いや}な{気持|きも}ちになる。
examples.english: When work emails come on my day off, it makes me feel a bit annoyed.

notes:
{休日|きゅうじつ} is a general term for any day off from work or school. Composed of {休|きゅう} (rest) + {日|じつ} (day).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {休日|きゅうじつ}{出勤|しゅっきん}: working on a day off
- {休日|きゅうじつ}{手当|てあて}: holiday pay/allowance
- {休日|きゅうじつ}を{過|す}ごす: to spend a day off
- {休日|きゅうじつ}を{楽|たの}しむ: to enjoy one's day off

CONTRAST:
- {休日|きゅうじつ}: day off (general — includes weekends and holidays)
- {祝日|しゅくじつ}: national holiday (officially designated)
- {平日|へいじつ}: weekday (opposite of {休日|きゅうじつ})
- {休暇|きゅうか}: vacation, leave (a period of days off, often planned)
- {定休日|ていきゅうび}: regular closing day (for shops and restaurants)
